payout_quote: Earn $25 plus your referral earns $25 once they join! ... Must be member in good standing to participate. HFDFCU member and referred new member (aged 18+) will each earn $25 dividend bonus on referred new member's joining HFDFCU.
steps: Be a current HFDFCU member in good standing.
Give your referral the official referral form (or have them complete it in-branch) with your name on it.
Your friend joins HFDFCU as a new member (aged 18+; membership eligibility required).
You earn a $25 dividend bonus and your referral earns a $25 dividend bonus on their joining HFDFCU.
catches: The referred person must be a genuinely new member - newly joined and previous members are not eligible, so no re-referring old friends who rejoined.
You must be a member in good standing; the offer is not transferrable.
Paid as a $25 dividend bonus (account credit), not cash in hand.
All offers subject to change or cancellation.
biggest_catch: The referral has to be a brand-new member aged 18+ - previous members and the already-joined don't count.
eligibility: Current HFDFCU members in good standing; referred persons must be 18+ and eligible for membership, and must be new (not previous) members.
timing: Bonus earned on the referred new member's joining HFDFCU (no explicit crediting window stated).
